data.long_meaning: The name Surbhi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Susrusha’ which means ‘sweet smelling’ or ‘golden’. In Hindu mythology, Surbhi is also the name of a celestial apsara or a goddess, who is known for her beauty and grace. The name Surbhi carries the meaning “Golden, Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Surbhi usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
